name: survey-creator-collaboration
description: Collaborative Survey Creator editing built on the journal plugin. The Node server is a reference implementation of the language-agnostic protocol (see PROTOCOL.md).

scripts.install:clients: npm --prefix lobby install && npm --prefix clients/react install && npm --prefix clients/vue install && npm --prefix clients/js install && npm --prefix clients/angular install
scripts.build:clients: npm run build:lobby && npm run build:react && npm run build:vue && npm run build:js && npm run build:angular
scripts.build:clients:local: npm run build:lobby:local && npm run build:react:local && npm run build:vue:local && npm run build:js:local && npm run build:angular:local
scripts.start: npm run build:clients && npm run server
scripts.dev:lobby:watch: concurrently -k -n core,react-ui,lobby "npm run watch:dev --prefix ../survey-library/packages/survey-core" "npm run watch:dev --prefix ../survey-library/packages/survey-react-ui" "npm run dev:lobby:local"
scripts.dev:react:watch: concurrently -k -n core,react-ui,creator-core,creator-react,react "npm run watch:dev --prefix ../survey-library/packages/survey-core" "npm run watch:dev --prefix ../survey-library/packages/survey-react-ui" "npm run watch:dev --prefix ../survey-creator/packages/survey-creator-core" "npm run watch:dev --prefix ../survey-creator/packages/survey-creator-react" "npm run dev:react:local"
scripts.dev:vue:watch: concurrently -k -n core,vue3-ui,creator-core,creator-vue,vue "npm run watch:dev --prefix ../survey-library/packages/survey-core" "npm run watch:dev --prefix ../survey-library/packages/survey-vue3-ui" "npm run watch:dev --prefix ../survey-creator/packages/survey-creator-core" "npm run watch:dev --prefix ../survey-creator/packages/survey-creator-vue" "npm run dev:vue:local"
scripts.dev:js:watch: concurrently -k -n core,js-ui,creator-core,creator-js,js "npm run watch:dev --prefix ../survey-library/packages/survey-core" "npm run watch:dev --prefix ../survey-library/packages/survey-js-ui" "npm run watch:dev --prefix ../survey-creator/packages/survey-creator-core" "npm run watch:dev --prefix ../survey-creator/packages/survey-creator-js" "npm run dev:js:local"
scripts.dev:angular:watch: concurrently -k -n core,creator-core,angular "npm run watch:dev --prefix ../survey-library/packages/survey-core" "npm run watch:dev --prefix ../survey-creator/packages/survey-creator-core" "npm run dev:angular:local"
